note: AUDIT ONLY. No route was edited, no official URL was removed, no authority shard was mutated and nothing was paid-acquired by this order. Scope: the 2 routes whose corroborating phone is shared between two properties, and the 11 census rows that carry no postal code. All 179 routes remain ROUTING_CONFIRMED and untouched. The Sheraton pair sits inside the no-postal set, so the union is 11 rows.

classification_vocabulary.ROUTE_STRONG: Two or more independent identity signals agree, at least one of them location-bearing (street, postal code, or a phone consistent with the row own geography).
classification_vocabulary.ROUTE_NEEDS_CORROBORATION: The doorway is plausible and is retained, but only the name agrees. No location-bearing signal is present.
classification_vocabulary.ROUTE_CONTRADICTED: A signal the route RECORDED as corroborating is demonstrably false for this property. Says nothing on its own about whether the URL is right.
classification_vocabulary.IDENTITY_HOLD: The identity itself is provisional or unresolved, so no policy evidence may bind to it.

separate_identity_holds_not_routes.identity_key: hotel indigo detroit north troy + even hotel detroit north troy
separate_identity_holds_not_routes.why: SHARED_ADDRESS dual-brand pair at 575 w big beaver|48084, also sharing phone 248-720-6400. Both carry DISTINCT official URLs and distinct IHG property records, so the routes are not in question; the open collision flag is an identity matter, not a routing one.

items.why: The route records identity_signals_matched ['name','phone'], but the phone it matched on -- 248-349-4000 -- is carried IDENTICALLY by 'Sheraton Detroit Novi Hotel' in the same census, and 248 is the Oakland County area code. Ann Arbor is Washtenaw County (734). The phone therefore corroborates nothing about this row and is positively inconsistent with the city the row itself states: one number cannot distinguish two properties, and this one names the wrong county. What is contradicted is the RECORDED SIGNAL, not the doorway -- the URL slug, the Marriott property code 'arbsi' (ARB is the Ann Arbor market code) and the canonical name all agree with each other and with the stated city.
items.remediation: Strike 'phone' from identity_signals_matched, leaving ['name'], which reclassifies this route as ROUTE_NEEDS_CORROBORATION alongside the other nine. Separately, treat the census phone field as unverified for this row -- it is more likely Novi's number copied onto the Ann Arbor row than a real Ann Arbor number. Both edits mutate the authority shard and are NOT made by this order.
items.url_disposition: RETAINED -- this order removes no official URL. A bad corroboration signal is not evidence that the doorway is wrong.
